While its documentary approvals and imprimaturs, in number, in weight, in dignity have been all-surpassing; most con- vincing in themselves and often most inspiring: still, if read with, at, least a decent degree of humility, the simple tho' master-introduction by the unassuming writer herself surpasses all others as befitting a work at once so inspired-like and so inspiring, so simple yet so surpassingly sublime. Deo Gr. Glory be to God.

regions.merged_text: IV. The unprecedented progress in the bloomingout these latter generations and ripening of devotion to Mary Immaculate Mother of God - Lourdes, Fatima, Lippa; Marian Congresses and study- clubs multiplying everywhere; and especially the dogmatic proclama- tions of the Immaculate Conception and of glorious Assumption, etc: all and each of these, not only suggest but positively plead for such a work, - a "life of the Blessed Virgin".

regions.merged_text: IV. The unprecedented progress in the blooming and ripening these later decades and generations in "Devotion to Mary" - Lourdes, Fatima, Lippa; Marian congresses and study-clubs multipling; defini- tions most solemnly proclaimed of the Immaculate Conception and of the Assumption, etc: - all these and each of them not only suggest but positively plead for such a work, an authentic "Life of the Blessed Virgin", - so supremely outstanding in the history of the Church and of the very life of Christianity and of religion, and of whom so remarkably little is detailed in the Gospel naratives. And most earnest of all, even to internationally-threatening is the demand occasioned by the steadily advancing avalanche of diabolical atheism just now so persistently menacing to every thought of God or of the supernatural - the demand - for positive, detailed - all the better if supernatural and superscientific knowledge of Mary Virgin-Mother and "CoRedemptrix with Jesus her divine Son.
